If everything passes, the task is complete.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "cd /app/task_file && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, collections, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/task_file/scripts')
from cost_model import CostModel, align, HEADS, HIDDEN
cm=CostModel(64)
pairs=[
 ('input_data/requests_bucket_1.jsonl','output_data/plan_b1.jsonl',{'cost':3.0e11,'pad_ratio':0.055,'p95_latency_ms':2.1e6,'sequential_timecost':2.7e8}),
 ('input_data/requests_bucket_2.jsonl','output_data/plan_b2.jsonl',{'cost':4.8e10,'pad_ratio':0.15,'p95_latency_ms':2.1e5,'sequential_timecost':3.2e7}),
]
all_shapes=set()
for inp,out,th in pairs:
    reqs=[json.loads(l) for l in open(inp)]
    req_map={r['request_id']:r for r in reqs}
    plan=[json.loads(l) for l in open(out)]
    ids=[p['request_id'] for p in plan]
    assert len(ids)==len(reqs)==800, (len(ids),len(reqs))
    assert set(ids)==set(req_map), 'id mismatch'
    assert len(ids)==len(set(ids)), 'dup ids'
    bsh=collections.defaultdict(set)
    for p in plan:
        sh=p['shape']
        assert sh['heads_align']==32 and sh['hidden_align']==4096, sh
        assert sh['seq_align']%64==0 and sh['seq_align']>=align(req_map[p['request_id']]['prompt_len'],64), (p,sh)
        bsh[p['batch_id']].add((sh['seq_align'],sh['heads_align'],sh['hidden_align']))
        all_shapes.add((sh['seq_align'],sh['heads_align'],sh['hidden_align']))
    assert all(len(s)==1 for s in bsh.values()), 'multi-shape batch'
    m=cm.plan_metrics(req_map,plan)
    print(out)
    for k,t in th.items():
        print(f'  {k}: {m[k]:.6e} threshold {t:.6e} {"OK" if m[k]<=t else "FAIL"}')
    print('  batches',len(bsh),'requests',len(plan))
print('unique shapes',len(all_shapes),sorted(all_shapes),'OK' if len(all_shapes)<=8 else 'FAIL')
PY
